content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IISER Bhopal Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IISER Bhopal Project Technical Support Staff III Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support Staff III: M.Sc. in Life Sciences or related subjects. Research experience in epigenetics/RNA biology/Cancer biology/NGS data analysis or related fields. Desirable: Prior three year experience with molecular biology techniques.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support Staff III: Maximum age limit is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support Staff III: Rs. 28000/Month+ 20% HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IISER Bhopal Project Technical Support Staff III Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISER Bhopal to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal (IISER Bhopal) for an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IISER Bhopal?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Technical Support Staff III under the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support Staff III position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IISER Bhopal Project Technical Support Staff III position is 4 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Life Sciences or related subjects along with relevant research experience in molecular biology techniques.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support Staff III post is 35 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What salary will be provided to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Support Staff III position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000 along with 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the Google application form provided through the official recruitment link before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IISER Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of applications followed by an interview round for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification, meaning candidates can apply without paying any application fee.
